status_effects.explanation: Reported genuine esteem and a discreet act of goodwill locally elevate Norpois, though the narrator's aside about his habitual malveillance limits how far this can be taken as settled.
The duchess actively includes him in the conversation and reports flattering, practically consequential esteem from Norpois, positioning him as valued within the company rather than sidelined.

appraisal_events.evidence: Il vous aime beaucoup... il est intelligent... il a eu la délicatesse de ne pas même parler de sa bonne intention à votre père qu'il apprécie infiniment.
appraisal_events.explanation: The duchess reports that Norpois genuinely esteems the narrator and quietly tried to help him, favorably characterizing Norpois, though the narrator's own following gloss about Norpois's habitual malice tempers how far this praise can be trusted.

appraisal_events.evidence: Vous le connaissez, je sais, me dit la Mme de Guermantes pour ne pas me laisser en dehors de la conversation... Il vous aime beaucoup... il a dernièrement voulu vous faire donner au ministère une situation charmante.
appraisal_events.explanation: The duchess deliberately draws the narrator into the conversation and relays that Norpois esteems him and tried to secure him a good position, staging him as favorably regarded within the group.
